battle.name: 第一次世界大戰
battle.brief: 西線戰場以密集的塹壕體系為主，雙方在漫長的戰壕中進行持久的消耗戰。德軍在此戰爭中大量使用MG 08重機槍，以其高射速壓制敵方步兵並防守陣地，發揮了關鍵的火力支援作用。

kit.name: MG 08重機槍
kit.history: MG 08在一次大戰的西線和東線被廣泛部署，其持續的火力在防守與進攻中均發揮了重要作用。

cause: 1914年6月28日，奧匈帝國皇儲弗朗茨·斐迪南在塞拉耶佛被塞爾維亞民族主義者加夫里洛·普林西普暗殺，此事件成為第一次世界大戰的導火線。隨後，奧匈帝國向塞爾維亞發出最後通牒，要求限制其境內的反奧宣傳並接受調查，儘管塞爾維亞幾乎接受了所有條款，奧匈帝國仍於7月28日對塞爾維亞宣戰。受同盟體系約束，俄羅斯於7月29日動員以支援塞爾維亞，德國則向俄羅斯發出最後通牒，要求停止動員，並在8月1日對俄羅斯宣戰。同一天，法國開始動員，德國隨即於8月3日對法國宣戰，並依據施里芬計畫，入侵中立國比利時，迫使英國於8月4日對德國宣戰。這一系列的 deadline、動員與最後通牒，將原本的巴爾幹危機迅速升級為一場席捲歐洲的大規模武裝衝突。
causeEn: June 28, 1914 – Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria‑Hungary was assassinated in Sarajevo by Serbian nationalist Gavrilo Princip, an act that became the spark for the First World War. Austria‑Hungary then issued an ultimatum to Serbia demanding the suppression of anti‑Austrian propaganda and acceptance of an investigation; although Serbia accepted almost all the terms, Austria‑Hungary declared war on Serbia on 28 July. Bound by the alliance system, Russia mobilized on 29 July to support Serbia, and Germany sent an ultimatum to Russia demanding a halt to mobilization, declaring war on Russia on 1 August. France began its own mobilization the same day, and Germany declared war on France on 3 August, launching the Schlieffen Plan by invading neutral Belgium, which forced Britain to declare war on Germany on 4 August. This cascade of ultimatums, mobilizations and declarations transformed a Balkan crisis into a continent‑wide armed conflict.
countries: 參與1914年戰爭的主要國家分為兩大陣營。協約國方面包括英國及其自治領（加拿大、澳洲、紐西蘭、印度等）、法國、俄羅斯帝國、比利時、塞爾維亞、蒙特內哥羅以及後來加入的日本與意大利（意大利於1915年加入）。同盟國方面則有德意志帝國、奧匈帝國、鄂圖曼帝國（1914年11月加入）以及保加利亞（1915年加入）。在歐洲本土，德國執行施里芬計畫，企圖快速穿越比利時包抄法國；法國則依據第十七號計畫，動員大批步兵向阿爾薩斯-洛林推進；俄羅斯在東線展開雙線作戰，於8月初向東普魯士進軍；英國遠征軍則在法國北部海岸登陸，與法軍共同構築防線。各參戰國的兵力動員規模龐大，德國動員約380萬人，法國動員約340萬人，俄羅斯動員約560萬人，英國則動員約10萬正規軍與約30萬後備役。這些國家在戰略、資源與軍事技術上的部署，構成了第一次世界大戰的基礎格局。
countriesEn: The main combatants in 1914 were split into two opposing alliances. The Allied Powers comprised the United Kingdom and its dominions (Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India, etc.), France, the Russian Empire, Belgium, Serbia, Montenegro, and later Japan and Italy (which entered the war in 1915). The Central Powers consisted of the German Empire, the Austro‑Hungarian Empire, the Ottoman Empire (which joined in November 1914) and later Bulgaria (1915). In Europe, Germany executed the Schlieffen Plan, aiming to swing quickly through Belgium and outflank France; France’s Plan XVII called for a frontal assault into Alsace‑Lorraine; Russia opened a two‑front war by invading East Prussia in early August; and the British Expeditionary Force landed on the French coast to link up with French forces. Mobilization figures were massive: Germany called up about 3.8 million men, France 3.4 million, Russia 5.6 million, and Britain some 100 000 regulars plus about 300 000 reserves. The strategic, material and technological dispositions of these nations formed the basic framework of the First World War.
people: 在這場戰爭的決策與指揮層面，出現了多位關鍵人物。德国方面，威廉二世皇帝作為最高統帥，親自批准施里芬計畫；參謀總長小毛奇（Helmuth von Moltke the Younger）負責將計畫付諸實踐；陸軍元帥埃里希·馮·法金漢（Erich von Falkenhayn）於1914年末接掌東線指揮。法國方面，總參謀長約瑟夫·喬佛雷（Joseph Joffre）主導第十七號計畫，率領法軍在邊境戰役中節節敗退後策劃馬恩河反攻；第5集團軍司令米歇爾·弗朗謝·德斯佩雷（Franchet d’Espèrey）在馬恩河會戰中發揮關鍵作用。英國方面，遠征軍總司令約翰·弗倫奇爵士（Sir John French）率部登陸法國，後由道格拉斯·海格（Douglas Haig）接任。俄國方面，沙皇尼古拉二世為最高統帥，參謀總長尼古拉·揚克維奇（Nikolai Yanushkevich）負責動員與作戰安排。巴爾幹战场上，塞爾維亞軍隊司令拉多萬·普特尼克（Radomir Putnik）多次抵禦奧匈帝國的侵略。這些人物在戰略制定、軍隊調動與前線指揮上，決定了1914年歐洲戰局的走向。
peopleEn: Several key individuals shaped the decisions and command of the war. On the German side, Emperor Wilhelm II acted as supreme commander, personally approving the Schlieffen Plan; his chief of the general staff, Helmuth von Moltke the Younger, was responsible for translating the plan into action; General Erich von Falkenhayn took over the eastern front command later in 1914. For France, Chief of Staff Joseph Joffre directed Plan XVII and, after the border battles, orchestrated the counter‑offensive on the Marne; the commander of the French Fifth Army, General Franchet d’Espèrey, played a decisive role in the Battle of the Marne. Britain’s Expeditionary Force was led initially by Sir John French, who landed in France, and later succeeded by General Douglas Haig. In Russia, Tsar Nicholas II was the nominal supreme commander, while Chief of Staff Nikolai Yanushkevich oversaw mobilization and operations. In the Balkans, Serbian commander Radomir Putnik repeatedly repelled Austro‑Hungarian invasions. These figures, through strategic planning, force movements and battlefield command, determined the course of the European war in 1914.
kits: 1914年的戰場上，各國軍隊主要配備當時已經列裝的武器與裝備。步兵步槍方面，德軍使用7.92×57mm口徑的毛瑟Gewehr 98步槍，配備尖頭彈；法軍標配8×50mm口徑的勒貝爾Lebel 1886步槍，採用無煙火藥子彈；英軍則配備.303英制口徑的李-恩菲爾德Lee‑Enfield No.1 Mk III步槍。機槍方面，德軍大量裝備7.92mm口徑的馬克沁MG08重機槍（仿製自英國馬克沁），法軍使用8mm口徑的霍特基斯Hotchkiss M1914機槍，英軍則配備同樣型號的馬克沁。炮兵方面，法軍以75mm野戰炮（Canon de 75 mm modèle 1897）聞名，其高速射擊與良好精準度在馬恩河會戰中發揮作用；德軍裝備77mm野戰炮（7.7 cm FK 96）以及105mm榴彈炮；英軍使用13噸重的18磅野戰炮（QF 18‑pounder）。此外，雙方皆配備輕型迫擊炮、火焰噴射器（德軍Flammenwerfer）以及早期的裝甲車與自行車傳令兵。步兵還配備金屬頭盔（如德軍的Pickelhaube）與基本的防毒面具，雖然化學武器在1914年尚未廣泛使用。這套裝備在1914年的歐洲战场上，形成了一套以步槍、機槍與火炮為核心的火力組合，對戰術與戰局產生深遠影響。
kitsEn: The 1914 battlefield saw the widespread use of weapons and equipment that had already been standardized before the war. Infantry rifles included the German 7.92×57 mm Mauser Gewehr 98, firing spitzer bullets; the French Lebel 1886 in 8×50 mm, employing smokeless powder; and the British .303‑inch Lee‑Enfield No. 1 Mk III. Machine guns were abundant: the Germans fielded the 7.92 mm Maxim MG 08 (a licence‑built copy of the original Maxim), the French the 8 mm Hotchkiss M1914, and the British also used the Maxim MG 08. In artillery, the French 75 mm field gun (Canon de 75 mm modèle 1897) was renowned for its high rate of fire and accuracy, crucial at the Marne; the Germans employed the 77 mm field gun (7.7 cm FK 96) and the 105 mm howitzer; the British used the 18‑pounder (QF 18‑pounder) weighing about 13 tons. Both sides also had light mortars, flame‑throwers (German Flammenwerfer) and early armored cars, while infantry wore metal helmets (such as the German Pickelhaube) and, though chemical weapons were not yet common, basic respirators. This mix of rifles, machine guns and artillery formed the core firepower that shaped tactics and the outcome of the early war.
tactics: 1914年的戰術思想仍停留在十九世紀末的機動戰與正面突破概念。德國依據施里芬計畫，以右翼兵團（由第1、第2、第3軍團組成）快速穿越比利時，試圖在法軍主力集結之前，包抄並殲滅法軍於巴黎以東。法國的第十七號計畫則主張對阿爾薩斯-洛林實施正面進攻，以奪回失地，並在東北部的色當（Sedan）設立防線。這兩種計畫在實踐中相遇於「邊境戰役」——8月的蒙斯（Mons）與沙勒羅瓦（Charleroi）戰鬥。蒙斯之戰中，英軍第1、第2師在麥克林上校的率領下，以少量兵力抵擋德軍第1軍團的猛攻，利用地形與機槍火力延緩敵軍前進；沙勒羅瓦之戰則因法軍第5集團軍側翼暴露而導致全線撤退。隨後的馬恩河會戰成為戰術轉折點：法軍在弗朗謝·德斯佩雷的指挥下，利用火車與卡車的高速調動，於9月5日至12日間組織起多路反攻，迫使德軍在沒有足夠後備的情況下退卻至埃納河（Aisne）。此役之後，雙方開始沿埃納河挖掘戰壕，標誌著「運動戰」向「消耗戰」的過渡，並在隨後的「海上競賽」中，出現了沿海岸線的側翼包抄戰鬥，雙方試圖突破對方的側翼，形成從瑞士到北海的連續戰線。這段時間的戰術包括：以鐵路快速集結師團、利用偵察機校對炮兵射擊、通訊以電報和有線電話為主、以及在必要時使用火焰噴射器與手榴彈進行近距離作戰。
tacticsEn: Tactical doctrine in 1914 still reflected the late‑nineteenth‑century concepts of maneuver and direct assault. Germany’s Schlieffen Plan called for a massive right‑wing sweep through Belgium, aiming to outflank and encircle the French army before it could fully mobilize. France’s Plan XVII advocated a direct offensive into Alsace‑Lorraine to recover lost territory and to hold the line at Sedan. These plans collided in the “Battle of the Frontiers” – the fighting at Mons and Charleroi in August. At Mons, the British 1st and 2nd Divisions, under General Sir Charles Monro, held off the German First Army with a handful of troops, using terrain and machine‑gun fire to delay the enemy. The Battle of Charleroi saw the French Fifth Army’s flank exposed, leading to a general retreat. The First Battle of the Marne (5‑12 September) marked the tactical turning point: Franchet d’Espèrey’s Fifth Army, aided by rapid rail and truck movements, launched coordinated counter‑attacks on multiple sectors, forcing the Germans, short of reserves, to fall back to the Aisne River. After the Marne, both sides began digging entrenchments along the Aisne, signaling the shift from maneuver warfare to a grinding war of attrition. The subsequent “Race to the Sea” saw each side attempt to outflank the other along the coast, creating a continuous line of trenches from the Swiss border to the North Sea. During this period tactics included rapid concentration of divisions by rail, use of reconnaissance aircraft for artillery spotting, communications via telegraph and field telephone, and close‑quarter fighting with hand grenades and flame‑throwers when necessary.
data: 以下是1914年若干關鍵行動的時間、兵力與物資數據。8月2日，德國向比利時提出通過要求，次日（8月4日）英國遠征軍第1、第2、第3師在法國加萊（Calais）登陸，總兵力約9萬人，攜帶約200門野戰炮。8月20日，德國第1軍團在卡爾·馮·克拉克（Karl von Einem）率領下於蒙斯與英軍交火，英軍在此役消耗彈藥約2.5萬發，損失慘重。8月21日至23日，法軍在沙勒羅瓦與德軍第2、第3軍團爆發激烈炮戰，法軍第5集團軍在此役損失慘重，炮彈消耗達120萬枚。9月5日至12日的馬恩河會戰，法軍投入第3、第4、第5集團軍共約150萬人，德軍則集結第1至第6軍團共約200萬人，雙方在此役共發射砲彈約1500萬發，步兵子彈消耗估計超過3億發。9月底至10月間的「海上競賽」中，德國遠洋艦隊在北海進行封鎖，英國皇家海軍在斯卡帕弗洛（Scapa Flow）集結，雙方在10月28日的多格灘（Dogger Bank）海戰中，英艦擊沉德艦「布萊梅」號（SMS Blücher），但未造成決定性影響。整體而言，1914年西線的日均彈藥消耗量約為每師2,000發炮彈與1,200,000發步槍子彈，後勤補給主要依賴鐵路與臨時搭建的公路運輸線。這些具體數據顯示出戰爭在機械化與火力密集方面的早期規模，對未來的消耗戰與持久戰提供了重要的參考依據。
dataEn: The following are specific dates, unit strengths and logistical data for several key operations of 1914. On 2 August Germany demanded free passage through Belgium; the next day, 4 August, the British Expeditionary Force’s 1st, 2nd and 3rd Divisions landed at Calais, total strength about 90 000 men with roughly 200 field guns. On 20 August the German First Army under General Karl von Einem clashed with British troops at Mons; the British forces expended roughly 25 000 rounds of ammunition and suffered heavy losses. From 21‑23 August the French Fifth Army fought the German 2nd and 3rd Armies at Charleroi, suffering heavy casualties and expending about 1.2 million shells. During the First Battle of the Marne (5‑12 September), the French deployed the 3rd, 4th and 5th Armies – about 1.5 million men – while the Germans assembled the 1st through 6th Armies – roughly 2 million men; together they fired an estimated 15 million shells and consumed over 300 million rifle cartridges. In late September‑October the “Sea Race” saw the German High Seas Fleet contest the North Sea, and on 28 October the British Royal Navy engaged German ships at the Dogger Bank, sinking the cruiser SMS Blücher, though the engagement did not produce a decisive result. Overall, the daily ammunition expenditure on the Western Front in 1914 was roughly 2 000 shells per division and 1.2 million rifle cartridges, with supply dependent mainly on railways and improvised road routes. These figures illustrate the scale of fire‑power and logistics that characterized the early phase of the war and set the stage for the prolonged attritional conflict that followed.
impact: 1914年的戰役在政治、社會與軍事層面留下深遠影響。首先，激烈的邊境戰鬥與馬恩河會戰迫使歐洲各國認清現代戰爭的高度消耗性，軍民死亡與物資損耗遠超以往，導致各國政府不得不實行全面的戰時經濟管制與兵役動員。其次，戰爭的快速擴展暴露了原有動員與後勤體系的不足：鐵路時刻表失靈、彈藥供給不及、前線通訊中斷等問題，促使各國加速軍事技術與後勤自動化的研發。再次，戰局的膠著與壕溝的出現，使得「消耗戰」成為未來數年的主導形態，對軍人的心理與身體都是前所未有的考驗，前線士兵感受到物資匱乏與恐慌。英國的遠征軍在蒙斯撤退後，輿論開始質疑政府的戰略判斷，導致後續政治人物的更迭；法國的第十七號計畫失敗，使軍方高層更替，喬佛雷在1916年被替換。此外，1914年的戰爭也刺激了殖民地的參與：日本在8月向德國宣戰，佔領德屬太平洋島嶼；印度派遣軍隊前往西線，標誌著全球化戰爭的開端。這些直接與間接的衝擊，為未來數年的戰略調整與國際秩序的重塑奠定了基礎。
impactEn: The campaigns of 1914 left profound political, social and military repercussions. The ferocious border battles and the Battle of the Marne revealed the unprecedented scale of modern warfare, with losses and material consumption far exceeding previous conflicts; consequently, governments were compelled to impose total war economies and mass conscription. The rapid expansion of the front exposed weaknesses in existing mobilization and logistical systems – railway timetables broke down, ammunition supplies lagged, and communications faltered – spurring the acceleration of military‑technical and logistical innovations. The stalemate and trench lines placed an enormous psychological and physical burden on soldiers, and the troops felt the pinch of shortages and fear. The British Expeditionary Force’s retreat from Mons sparked public doubt about the government’s strategic judgment, leading to later changes in political leadership; the failure of France’s Plan XVII caused a reshuffle of the high command, with Joffre replaced in 1916. The 1914 war also drew colonial powers into the conflict: Japan declared war on Germany in August and seized German Pacific islands, while India sent troops to the Western Front, marking the beginning of a truly global war. These immediate and indirect consequences laid the groundwork for the strategic adjustments and the reshaping of the international order that would dominate the coming years.
result: 截至1914年底，第一次世界大戰的結果尚無決定性胜负。西線在馬恩河會戰後形成從瑞士山脊至北海的連續壕溝，雙方皆無法再進行大規模的機動突破，標誌著「運動戰」的結束與長期消耗戰的開始。東線方面，俄軍在1914年夏季的兩次入侵東普魯士（坦能堡與馬蘇里亞恩湖）皆以失敗告終，德軍成功殲滅俄軍第2集團軍，迫使俄軍退回本土，但仍未能取得決定性勝利。海上方面，英德兩國海軍在北海的對峙升級，英國實施海上封鎖，德國則以潜艇進行報復性襲擊，雙方皆未能在1914年取得制海權。總體而言，1914年的戰爭結束於一種膠著狀態——雙方都在努力鞏固已取得的陣地，並為來年的更大規模消耗做準備。這一年標誌著20世紀的戰爭形態從傳統的機動與會戰，轉向以火力、持久與消耗為核心的新模式，對後續數年的戰略與技術發展產生了深遠影響。
resultEn: By the end of 1914 the First World War had produced no decisive victor. On the Western Front the Battle of the Marne resulted in a continuous line of trenches stretching from the Swiss Alps to the North Sea, preventing either side from carrying out large‑scale maneuver. The Eastern Front saw the Russian invasions of East Prussia in the summer of 1914 end in failure at Tannenberg and the Masurian Lakes, where the Germans destroyed the Russian Second Army, forcing the Russians back to their own territory but failing to achieve a conclusive triumph. At sea, the British and German fleets contested the North Sea; Britain instituted a naval blockade while Germany responded with submarine warfare, but neither side secured control of the seas in 1914. In sum, the year closed in a state of deadlock – both belligerents were consolidating their positions and preparing for the larger, grinding attrition that would dominate the following years. 1914 thus marked the transition from the era of maneuver and set‑piece battles to a new mode of warfare centered on fire‑power, endurance and attrition, profoundly influencing the strategy and technology of the conflict that followed.
